assets.name: NASA MER Blender source — component display
assets.creator: NASA/JPL-Caltech
assets.modifications: Converted from NASA Blender source at saved frame 1243 with current-frame export, without animation, cameras, lights or geometry modifiers. 21 helper controls remain transform-only nodes; 40 hardware objects remain. NASA source viewport visibility retained (two arm objects have source hide_render true but are viewport-visible). Original official MER static materials and embedded textures copied by identical material names. Proportions, mesh vertices, normals, UVs, hierarchy and source pose retained. Exploded display instances add radial offsets only in the application; these are not a documented disassembly sequence.
assets.usage: NASA educational and informational media conditions; retain creator/source credits, third-party notices and no NASA endorsement.
